field: Eye-balling a 24-inch (600mm (24 in)) cantilever on 2x10 joists because 'we always do it'.
code: NBC Rule 9.23.9.9 limits dimensional joist cantilevers supporting exterior walls to a maximum of 400mm (16 in) unless engineered.
tip: Always answer the Red Seal based on strict NBC minimums, never site shortcuts!

field: Letting risers vary by up to 1/2 inch (12mm) across a flight and making it up at the bottom step.
code: NBC Section 9.8.4 limits the maximum tolerance variance between any adjacent risers to 6mm (1/4 in) and 1/4 inch across the entire flight.
tip: Consistency is critical for safety; the Red Seal exam tests strict uniform limits.

field: Driving 3 nails into a studs-to-plates connection at random angles.
code: NBC Table 9.23.3.4 explicitly requires 4 toe-nails (82mm / 3-1/4") or 2 end-nails (82mm / 3-1/4") for joists/studs to plates.
tip: Red Seal examinations test strict fastener schedules from Table 9.23.3.4.

field: Assuming a couple of gable vents are more than enough for a large attic space.
code: NBC Section 9.19.1.2 requires the free ventilation area to be at least 1/300 of the insulated ceiling area (or 1/150 for flat roofs/low slopes).
tip: Attic ventilation ratios are a classic exam math question. Remember the 1/300 ratio rule.

field: Hacking out 50% of a load-bearing exterior wall stud to run 2" plumbing pipes.
code: NBC Rule 9.23.5.1 states that load-bearing studs cannot be notched or drilled more than 25% of their depth (or 33% for non-bearing studs) unless reinforced.
tip: Exceeding notch thresholds weakens structure. The 25% limit for bearing studs is highly tested.

field: Placing anchor bolts only at the corners of sill plates and every 8-10 feet.
code: NBC Rule 9.20.17 requires foundation anchor bolts (minimum 12.7mm diameter) to be spaced no more than 2.4 meters (8 feet) apart.
tip: Always remember the 2.4m (8 ft) max spacing and placement within 300mm of plate ends.

field: Installing a window in a basement bedroom that 'looks big enough' for a person to slide through.
code: NBC Rule 9.9.10.1 requires bedroom egress windows to provide an unobstructed opening of not less than 0.35 m² (3.8 sq ft) with no dimension less than 380mm (15 in).
tip: A bedroom window must serve as an emergency exit. Memorize 0.35 m² and 380mm dimensions.
